displayName: Do due diligence on a vendor or supplier
summary: Research a company before signing on and surface any credibility concerns or red flags.

useCases.title: Do due diligence on a vendor or supplier
useCases.message: Help me do due diligence on a vendor I am considering. Ask me which company and what the relationship would involve. Then research their reputation, client reviews, press coverage, and any concerning signals. Give me a clear summary with anything I should ask before signing.
